- [USER] User is interested in measuring sweat rate to determine water consumption during workouts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To measure sweat rate, weigh yourself before and after a workout, calculate the weight difference in kilograms, convert to milliliters by multiplying by 1,000, add fluid consumed during the workout, and divide by workout duration in hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Experts recommend drinking between 17-20 ounces of water for every pound of weight lost during exercise to stay hydrated.
- [USER] User is considering using a smart water bottle to track water intake during workouts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tools to measure sweat rate include:

  4. Hydration calculator
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listening to the body and recognizing signs of dehydration, such as thirst, headache, dizziness, and dark-colored urine, is essential.
